summary: Recommends collections depend only on ansible-core, but otherwise list dependencies in galaxy.yml and set the ansible-core version in meta/runtime.yml. Git repo dependencies are fine for local development but not for published collections.
questions: How do I declare that my collection needs another collection?
Where do I set the minimum ansible-core version for my collection?
Can a published collection depend on a Git repository?

answer_card.title: Collection dependencies
answer_card.answer_md:
- Prefer standalone collections depending only on ansible-core.
- Otherwise list collections under `dependencies` in `galaxy.yml`.
- Set required ansible-core in `meta/runtime.yml`.
- Git dependencies are OK for local dev: `dependencies: {'git@github.com:organization/repo_name.git': 'devel'}`
- **Don't** use Git deps in published collections; they must depend on published collections.
